CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #9
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

2. Which response best shows understanding of Faith in God Elisha? (1 mark)
   A. Use Faith in God Elisha to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Faith in God Elisha.
   C. Apply the teaching of Faith in God Elisha with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Faith in God Elisha has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of My Purpose? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My Purpose.
